newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem scoffs at criticism of mansion.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem scoffs at criticism of mansion.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem replied on Sunday to critics who attacked him for building a mansion and an airstrip in his tiny hometown, saying they were jealous of his success.
"The truth always triumphs," he said in his hometown of Anillaco in the northwestern province of La Rioja. "(The critics) are obviously jealous of success."
A recent television programme raised questions about the financing of the ranch-style house, which includes a private zoo and a lake with trout.
The programme aired by TV channel America 2 also asked why a small town of only 850 inhabitants needed a new full-length runway built by the air force.
But the people of Anillaco have rallied around their hero, saying the airstrip will boost the local olive industry.
A cheering crowd greeted Menem with posters that said "Power to the President."
Menem was governor of La Rioja before becoming president of Argentina. The Peronist leader is in his second term.
